title: Compounding Risks: Economic Incentive Misalignment × Capability Release — When Commercial Pressure Overrides Safety Commitments

original_idea.body:
# Compounding Risks: Economic Incentive Misalignment × Capability Release — When Commercial Pressure Overrides Safety Commitments

**Problem:** AI labs face commercial pressure to release more capable models quickly. This economic incentive compounds with dual-use governance risk when labs release models before governance frameworks are updated for their new capability level.

**Direction:** Analyze the publicly available timeline between when Anthropic/OpenAI determined models were near capability thresholds and when governance frameworks were updated vs. when models were commercially released. Measure the commercial release lead time over governance update. Correlate with competitive dynamics (competitor release dates).

**Why it matters:** Documenting the empirical pattern of commercial-pressure-driven governance lag provides evidence for whether voluntary governance commitments can survive competitive market pressures.

**Relevant context:** Anthropic gray zone and Mythos commercial timeline; GPT-5.3-Codex capability threshold timing; Bengio et al. incentive alignment gap.
